faq.a: The first-bug video is free. The audit is $349 and credited in full toward the work. After that there are five fixed packages: Launch-ready sprint $1,500–$2,500, Full rescue $3,000–$6,000, AI build $2,000–$8,000, MVP build $6,000–$20,000 and the Care plan at $299/mo. No hourly billing.

faq.q: Why is the audit paid when the first bug is free?
faq.a: The video shows you one real problem. The audit checks everything and gives you a ranked plan — that takes a day or two of Anadi’s time. Book the fix within 30 days and every dollar is credited.

faq.q: What if the audit finds nothing?
faq.a: If there are no real, fixable issues, you get a full refund.

faq.q: How does “pay when it’s live” work?
faq.a: You pay half to start. The second half is due only once the fix is live and you’ve confirmed it works.

faq.q: How will I know what’s happening?
faq.a: You get a ticket number the moment you send your request. Every step shows in request tracking and in your inbox, with a written update every day while work is in progress.

faq.q: What if you can’t fix it?
faq.a: The price is fixed. If something wasn’t in the quote, you’re not billed for it.

faq.q: Do you rebuild my app from scratch?
faq.a: No. Only the broken parts get rewritten, so your features and design stay as they are.

faq.q: What if my app is too far gone?
faq.a: The audit will say so plainly. Sometimes a partial rebuild is cheaper than patching — you’ll know before you pay for anything.

faq.q: Is my code safe with you?
faq.a: An NDA is available on request, and you can revoke repo access as soon as the project ends.

faq.q: Which tools and stacks do you support?
faq.a: React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js and PostgreSQL products (plus Supabase and Firebase) — hand-written or built with AI tools like Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, Bolt, v0 or Replit.

faq.q: What do you need to start?
faq.a: A link to your app. Repo access helps if you have it, but it isn’t required for the free audit.
